name: Habanero Pepper
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO patients due to low FODMAP content, though extreme heat may irritate sensitive digestive systems.
preparationTips: Remove seeds and membrane to reduce heat while maintaining flavor
Wear gloves when handling to avoid skin and eye irritation
Start with very small amounts (1/4 pepper) to test heat tolerance
Pairs well with lime juice to balance intense heat
nutritionalHighlights: Extremely high in vitamin C (more than citrus fruits)
Good source of vitamin A and carotenoids
Very low in calories and carbohydrates
